desc: convert a PBM image into a GEM .img file
r: pbmtogem - convert a PBM image into a GEM .img file

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

pbmtogem reads a PBM image as input and produces a compressed GEM .img file as output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for pbmtogem, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
